decisions.title: Bernalillo County Public Works Submittal and Development Standards for Large-Scale Solar Development
decisions.description: Establishes Bernalillo County Public Works submittal and development requirements for utility-scale solar, community solar, and battery storage in unincorporated areas, covering site plans, drainage, traffic, environmental review, decommissioning, construction, operations, and financial assurance.
decisions.provenance_status: official County Technical Standards page and byte-identical County-hosted file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative nine-page signed PDF preserved without modification.
Exact size and SHA-256 recorded; representative first, middle, and final pages were rendered and visually reviewed.
The document is dated August 4, 2026 and is the current solar-development standards file linked by the County.

decisions.title: Stormwater Management Guidance for Large-Scale Ground-Mounted Solar Arrays
decisions.description: Sets Bernalillo County criteria for grading and drainage review of ground-mounted photovoltaic arrays, including slopes, soils, setbacks, runoff calculations, vegetation, erosion controls, green stormwater infrastructure, maintenance, inspections, and post-construction monitoring.
decisions.provenance_status: official County Technical Standards page and byte-identical County-hosted file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative ten-page signed PDF preserved without modification.
Exact size and SHA-256 recorded; representative first, middle, and final pages were rendered and visually reviewed.
The document is dated March 14, 2025 and identifies itself as version 2 updated March 2025.

decisions.title: Bernalillo County Public Works Division Fee Schedule
decisions.description: Lists Bernalillo County Public Works fees for drainage review, grading and paving permits, infrastructure design review, utilities, driveways, excavation, traffic barricading, review extensions, moratorium work, and non-County-sponsored projects as of July 24, 2024.
decisions.provenance_status: official County Technical Standards page and byte-identical County-hosted file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative three-page PDF preserved without modification.
Exact size and SHA-256 recorded; all three rendered fee-schedule pages were visually reviewed.
The live County Technical Standards page remains the source of truth for later fee revisions.
